explanation: Under the 1933 constitution the president appointed and dismissed the head of government, and that was almost all the office could do. A stroke disabled Salazar in September 1968, and the choice of successor was Tomás's alone. He chose Caetano rather than a hardliner or a caretaker, and he did not consult the man being replaced. The 1965 election put Tomás there with a term running to 1972 and no one able to remove him.
